audience: solar installers and sales teams who keep leads and customers in SolarPlus CRM

useCases.title: Look up a contact with its status and address
useCases.text: Read one contact by its ID, with the name, email, phone, full address, status, source and notes.

useCases.title: Check the contact fields before you enter data
useCases.text: List the built-in contact fields with their types and select options. Then list the custom fields that the company set up.

useCases.title: Add a new lead with its full address
useCases.text: Create a contact from a first name, last name, email and full address. The contact is created as a lead by default.

useCases.title: Update a contact's status or notes
useCases.text: Change the given fields of one contact, such as its status or notes. Fields you leave out keep their current value.
